description: Trinkwassergewinnungsgebiete der Stadt Osnabrück is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geo.osnabrueck.de. Delimitation of drinking water production areas. According to § 91, 92 of the Lower Saxony Water Act (Niedersächsisches Wassergesetz, NWG), water protection areas may be established in the interest of public water supply in order to protect groundwater in the catchment area of a water abstraction from adverse effects. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Drinking water production areas of the city of Osnabrück" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include inspireidentifiziert. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
